summary: The repeat of the corrected resurrected-voter experiment (receipt 7adf927d528b4a74942c03b155aa8557) reproduced identical values and all four comparison outcomes — resurrected membership violated at index 1, premature commit violated at index 3 (write acknowledged, entry index 10, A committed and applied 10, B still at 9), and the control refusing the same write at index 7 — so the premature-commit consequence is not a single-run timing artifact. The child interpretation now cites both the corrected run and its repeat, with the superseded first revision cited only for the membership observation it reached, and the repeat recorded as counterevidence against a timing explanation. I also removed the parent's stale 'requested in this update' limitations now that the progress losses and the premature-commit consequence have retained receipts, and recorded the negative result of a source check on snapshot selection (candidates ranked by term then index, so the newest snapshot is chosen; no defect claimed there).
